data.fund_name: Aditya Birla Sun Life CRISIL-IBX Financial Services 3 to 6 Months Debt Index Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended Constant Maturity Index Fund tracking the CRISIL-IBX Financial Services 3 to 6 Months Debt Index. A relatively low interest rate risk and relatively low credit risk.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to generate returns corresponding to the total returns of the securities as represented by the CRISIL-IBX Financial Services 3 to 6 Months Debt Index before expenses, subject to tracking errors. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Instruments forming part of the CRISIL-IBX Financial Services 3 to 6 months Debt Index- 95% to 100% Debt and Money Market Instruments and Cash and Cash Equivalent - 0% to 5%
data.benchmark: CRISIL-IBX Financial Services 3 to 6 Months Debt Index
